title: zpp project file v0.6.2
description: A project file of Zametek.ProjectPlan (.zpp), version v0.6.2. zpp and the application read the older versions too, and they save each project in this version. docs/PROJECT-FILE.md gives the rules that a schema cannot say.

Version.description: The version of the format. zpp reads the file as this version.

Root.description: The id of the root of the tree of scenarios. The root is not a node. A node at the top of the tree has this id as its ParentId.

Current.description: The id of the scenario that zpp and the application load. When no item of Files has this id, they load the scenario of the last node, if it has an item.

ParentId.description: The id of the folder that the node is in, or Root.

NodeType.description: A scenario has an item in Files, and a folder has none. (0: File, 1: Folder)

IsTracked.description: The scenario chart shows the scenario as a point.

Nodes.description: The tree of scenarios: each folder and each scenario. A plan with no nodes gets one new, empty scenario, and zpp ignores Files.

NodeId.description: The id of the node of the scenario.

ProjectStart.description: The start that the plan asks for. Day 0 of the schedule is the first working day on this date or after it (EffectiveProjectStart).

EffectiveProjectStart.description: Calculated: the first working day on ProjectStart or after it, which is day 0 of the schedule. A time of an activity is a number of working days from it. zpp calculates it again when it reads the file.

Id.description: The id of the activity. Each activity of a scenario has an id of its own.

TargetResources.description: The ids of the resources that can do the activity.

AllocatedToResources.description: Calculated: the ids of the resources that do the activity. zpp calculates them again when it compiles.

Duration.description: Calculated: the duration that the compiler schedules, in working days. It is (O + 4 × ML + P + 3) / 6 in whole days, from the estimates. zpp calculates it again when it reads the file. Thus, set MostLikelyDuration, or leave it out and set Duration, which is then the most likely duration.

MostLikelyDuration.description: The most likely duration (ML), in working days. Without it, the most likely duration is Duration. A value below 0 is 0.

OptimisticDuration.description: The optimistic duration (O), in working days. Without it, O is ML. A value above ML is ML.

PessimisticDuration.description: The pessimistic duration (P), in working days. Without it, P is ML. A value below ML is ML.

FreeSlack.description: Calculated: the free slack, in working days. zpp calculates it again when it compiles.

EarliestStartTime.description: Calculated: the earliest start, in working days from ProjectStart. zpp calculates it again when it compiles.

LatestFinishTime.description: Calculated: the latest finish, in working days from ProjectStart. zpp calculates it again when it compiles.

MinimumFreeSlack.description: The free slack that the activity must keep, in working days.

MinimumEarliestStartTime.description: The earliest day on which the activity can start, in working days from ProjectStart. MinimumEarliestStartDateTime takes its place when the file has both.

MinimumEarliestStartDateTime.description: The earliest day on which the activity can start, as a date. It takes the place of MinimumEarliestStartTime.

MaximumLatestFinishTime.description: The latest day by which the activity must finish, in working days from ProjectStart. MaximumLatestFinishDateTime takes its place when the file has both.

MaximumLatestFinishDateTime.description: The latest day by which the activity must finish, as a date. It takes the place of MaximumLatestFinishTime.

Dependencies.description: The ids of the activities that must finish before this activity can start.

ResourceDependencies.description: Calculated: the dependencies that the scheduling of the resources adds. zpp calculates them again when it compiles.

Successors.description: Calculated: the ids of the activities that depend on this activity. zpp calculates them again when it compiles.

Metrics.description: The metrics of the last compile. zpp calculates them again when it compiles the scenario. The scenario chart shows them for a tracked scenario that zpp does not compile.

ResourceMetrics.description: The metrics of each resource from the last compile. zpp calculates them again when it compiles the scenario.

SimulationSummary.description: The result of the last run of the simulation, if the scenario has one.

ArrowGraphEdgeRoutingMode.description: 0: None, 1: Spline, 2: SplineBundling, 3: StraightLine, 4: SugiyamaSplines, 5: Rectilinear, 6: RectilinearToCenter

VertexGraphEdgeRoutingMode.description: 0: None, 1: Spline, 2: SplineBundling, 3: StraightLine, 4: SugiyamaSplines, 5: Rectilinear, 6: RectilinearToCenter

Files.description: The data of each scenario: one item for each node of the type File. A folder has no item.
